questions.prompt: Which statement gives the core rule for “OTA, partitions, and rollback”?
options: ESP-IDF selects the chip target before building.
The ESP32 name alone does not guarantee pin or radio compatibility; check the exact part.
Rollback provides a path back to a known-good image.
ESP32 family members do not all have the same radios and peripherals.
questions.answer: Rollback provides a path back to a known-good image.
questions.explanation:
Rollback provides a path back to a known-good image.
Why: OTA can write firmware to an inactive partition. Design partition layout, image size, signature/version checks, health confirmation, and rollback together.

This example calls the ESP-IDF OTA partition API from an Arduino-ESP32 sketch. Partition selection, rollback, and signature verification are not generic Arduino APIs. ArduinoOTA/Update can support simpler update flows, but secure rollback needs explicit ESP-IDF partition and verification configuration.
